nodes.description: Ownable.owner: public address state variable holding the contract owner; initialized to msg.sender in the old-style constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Ownable() old-style constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner: validates newOwner != address(0), emits OwnershipTransferred and reassigns owner.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender == address(1080614020421183795110940285280029773222128095634), a hardcoded literal address instead of the owner state variable.
SoloToken.name: public token name string set in the constructor.
SoloToken.symbol: public token symbol string set in the constructor.
SoloToken.decimals: public uint8 number of decimals set in the constructor.
SoloToken.totalSupply: public uint256 total supply, set once in the constructor and never updated by mint.
SoloToken.balances mapping(address => uint256) of account token balances, written by constructor, transfer, transferFrom and mint.
SoloToken.allow mapping(address => bool) permission flag checked in transferFrom and toggled by addAllow.
SoloToken.allowed mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) ERC20 allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
SoloToken constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint8 _decimals, uint256 _totalSupply): sets metadata, totalSupply, mints entire supply to msg.sender and sets allow[msg.sender] = true.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public: checks _to != 0 and sufficient balance, then SafeMath sub/add on balances and emits Transfer.
balanceOf(address _owner) public view returning balances[_owner].
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public: checks balance, allowance and allow[_from], then SafeMath sub/add on balances and decreases allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public: directly sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval (classic ERC20 approve race condition).
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
addAllow(address holder, bool allowApprove) external onlyOwner: owner-only toggle of the allow[holder] whitelist flag.
mint(address miner, uint256 _value) external onlyOwner: overwrites balances[miner] = _value without increasing totalSupply or preserving prior funds.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, allowance keys and balance lookups.
Unsafe state write: mint() assigns balances[miner] = _value, destroying existing balances and desynchronizing totalSupply from the sum of balances.
Unsafe authorization write: approve() overwrites the allowance unconditionally, enabling the ERC20 approve/transferFrom front-running race.
Unsafe access control: onlyOwner compares msg.sender to a hardcoded literal address rather than the owner state variable, so transferOwnership cannot actually transfer privileges.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure with overflow assertion assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returning a / b.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure with underflow assertion assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure with overflow assertion assert(c >= a).
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter _to of transfer(address _to, uint256 _value), the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(address _to, uint256 _value), the amount transferred.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value), the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value), the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value), the amount transferred.
Parameter _spender of approve(address _spender, uint256 _value).
Parameter _value of approve(address _spender, uint256 _value), the granted allowance.
Parameter holder of addAllow(address holder, bool allowApprove).
Parameter allowApprove of addAllow(address holder, bool allowApprove).
Parameter miner of mint(address miner, uint256 _value), the account whose balance is overwritten.
Parameter _value of mint(address miner, uint256 _value), the balance assigned to miner.
Local variable c in SafeMath.mul holding a * b for the overflow assertion.
Local variable c in SafeMath.add holding a + b for the overflow assertion.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Ownable constructor, granting ownership to the deployer.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against a hardcoded address literal for authorization.
OnlyOwner guard flows into the unsafe operation where the privileged address is hardcoded instead of read from owner.
The newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership's zero-address check and ownership assignment.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the owner state variable, but onlyOwner is bound to a hardcoded address.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The SoloToken constructor assigns the whole totalSupply and allow[msg.sender] = true to the untrusted deployer address.
Constructor initializes balances[msg.sender] with the created totalSupply.
Constructor sets allow[msg.sender] = true, whitelisting the deployer for transferFrom.
Constructor writes the immutable-in-practice totalSupply value.
Recipient address _to flows into transfer's zero-address check and balance credit.
Amount _value flows into transfer's SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balances.
msg.sender selects the debited balance in transfer.
transfer mutates the balances mapping with SafeMath sub and add.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
Amount parameters in this contract follow the same unchecked-assignment pattern seen in mint.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Debited account _from flows into transferFrom's balance, allow and allowance checks.
Recipient _to flows into transferFrom's zero-address check and balance credit.
Amount _value flows into transferFrom's SafeMath sub/add arithmetic and allowance decrement.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of allowed[_from][msg.sender] and of allow checks in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balances with SafeMath sub/add.
transferFrom decreases the allowed allowance with SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom requires allow[_from] == true, an extra owner-controlled whitelist gate.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub twice (balance and allowance).
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
Spender address _spender flows into approve's allowance key.
Allowance amount _value flows into the allowed mapping write in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve flows into the unsafe unconditional allowance overwrite enabling the ERC20 approve race.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
holder parameter flows into addAllow's whitelist key.
allowApprove boolean flows into allow[holder], controlling who may use transferFrom.
addAllow writes the owner-controlled allow whitelist mapping.
addAllow is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
miner parameter is used as the key of the balances overwrite in mint.
_value is assigned directly to balances[miner] in mint, bypassing SafeMath and totalSupply accounting.
mint overwrites balances[miner] = _value, destroying prior balance and desynchronizing totalSupply.
mint flows into the unsafe privileged balance-overwrite operation protected only by the hardcoded-address onlyOwner guard.
mint is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint never updates totalSupply, so supply accounting diverges from the sum of balances.
Local variable c holds a * b and is asserted against b in SafeMath.mul to detect overflow.
Local variable c holds a + b and is asserted >= a in SafeMath.add to detect overflow.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a plain argument of transferOwnership and carries no independent security semantics.
_to is only used inside transfer for recipient validation and credit.
_value is only used inside transfer for SafeMath balance arithmetic.
_from is only used inside transferFrom for balance, whitelist and allowance lookups.
_to is only used inside transferFrom for recipient validation and credit.
_value is only used inside transferFrom for SafeMath arithmetic and allowance decrement.
_spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
_value is only stored as the allowance inside approve.
holder is only used as the allow mapping key inside addAllow.
allowApprove is only used as the value written to allow[holder].
miner is only used as the key of the balances overwrite in mint.
_value directly becomes the overwritten balance in the unsafe mint operation, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The local c only exists to hold the product checked inside SafeMath.mul.
The local c only exists to hold the sum checked inside SafeMath.add.
